fer.hero_title: Grow Your Escape Room Business with
fer.hero_subtitle: The all-in-one platform designed exclusively for escape rooms. Manage bookings, engage players, and increase revenue — all from one dashboard.
fer.features_subtitle: From booking management to player engagement, we provide all the tools your escape room needs to thrive.
fer.feat_booking_desc: Accept bookings 24/7 through our widget on your website. Manage time slots, capacity, and availability with ease. Players can book directly, reducing phone calls and manual work.
fer.feat_widget_desc: Add our booking widget to your existing website with a single line of code. Fully themed to match your brand. Works on any website platform — WordPress, Wix, custom, etc.
fer.feat_dashboard_desc: A complete control center to manage rooms, track bookings, monitor revenue, and view analytics. Everything in one place, accessible from any device.
fer.feat_analytics_desc: Track your performance with detailed statistics: bookings per room, revenue trends, peak hours, and player demographics. Make data-driven decisions.
fer.feat_photos_desc: Capture team photos after each game and share them instantly. Players receive their photos via a unique link — a great way to boost social sharing and word-of-mouth.
fer.feat_listing_desc: Your rooms are listed on unlocked.gr where thousands of escape room fans discover new experiences. Get found by players searching by location, theme, or difficulty.
fer.feat_payments_desc: Take full payments or deposits online, straight into your own Stripe or Viva account. Players can still choose to pay on arrival if you allow it.
fer.feat_website_desc: Need a website? Our team builds professional, SEO-optimized websites tailored for escape rooms. Mobile-friendly, fast, and designed to convert visitors into bookers.
fer.pricing_subtitle: Pay per booking, or one flat price. No hidden fees, no surprises.
fer.how_subtitle: Four simple steps to get your escape room on UNLOCKED.
fer.how_step1_desc: Register your company on business.unlocked.gr. It's free and takes less than 2 minutes.
fer.how_step2_desc: Set up your escape rooms with descriptions, photos, pricing, difficulty levels, and time slots.
fer.how_step3_desc: Copy and paste our booking widget code into your website. Your players can start booking instantly.
fer.how_step4_desc: Track bookings, analyze performance, and reach new players through the UNLOCKED platform.
fer.faq1_q: How much does it cost to join UNLOCKED?
fer.faq1_a: You can start completely free. The Free plan includes portal access, a booking widget, and basic room management. You only pay €1.50 + VAT per widget booking. Paid plans (Starter from €58/mo, Pro from €98/mo, Enterprise from €198/mo) remove per-booking fees and add advanced features.
fer.faq2_q: How does the booking widget work?
fer.faq2_a: Our widget is a small piece of code you embed on your website. It displays your available time slots and lets visitors book directly. Bookings are synced in real-time to your dashboard. The widget is fully responsive and matches your brand colors.
fer.faq3_q: Can I use UNLOCKED with my existing website?
fer.faq3_a: Absolutely! The booking widget works on any website — WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, custom HTML, or any other platform. Just paste the embed code and it works.
fer.faq4_a: Subscriptions are processed securely through Stripe. You can pay monthly or yearly (save 17% with annual billing). For the Free plan, per-booking fees are invoiced monthly.
fer.faq5_q: How long does the review process take?
fer.faq5_a: After you register and select a plan, our team reviews your application. This typically takes 1-2 business days. You'll be notified by email once approved.
fer.faq6_a: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.
fer.faq7_q: Do you build websites for escape rooms?
fer.faq7_a: Yes! We offer professional website development services starting from €500. Our sites are built with escape rooms in mind — fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-optimized, and integrated with the UNLOCKED booking system.
fer.faq8_q: What kind of support do you offer?
fer.faq8_a: All plans include email support. Pro plans get priority support with faster response times. Enterprise plans include a dedicated account manager and 24/7 phone & chat support.
fer.cta_subtitle: Join UNLOCKED today and start reaching more players, managing bookings effortlessly, and growing your revenue.

dir.seo_title: Your Global Guide to Escape Rooms
dir.seo_p1: UNLOCKED is the all-in-one platform for discovering and booking escape rooms worldwide. Whether you are planning a trip abroad or looking for the best puzzle adventure in your city, our directory helps you compare themes, read player reviews, and book instantly.
dir.seo_p2: From the horror rooms of Budapest to the sci-fi adventures of Tokyo, every city has its own unique escape room culture. Use our city guides to find top-rated rooms, compare prices, and get insider tips before you play.

dir.tip_1: Book online in advance — popular rooms fill up fast, especially on weekends.
dir.tip_2: Bring the right group size. Most rooms are designed for 2–6 players for the best experience.

dir.tip_4: Communicate with your team. Share clues and work together to beat the clock.

dir.tip_6: Start with a medium difficulty room and work your way up to harder challenges.
